allowed_claim_while_open: Berut may remain a summary-level lower-bound support row with a propagated interval and one exact figure-level locator.
blocked_claim_while_open: Do not describe Berut as a row-level source-normalized benchmark row or as if one exact numeric source point were already archived.
promotion_value_if_closed: Would move Berut from figure-level summary support toward one numeric-point-or-stronger-surface provenance package.
